_about: Every line Word 16.106 drew for each document of tools/make_script_probe.py: the baselines in 1/300-inch device px of each page, paragraph by paragraph (the text is the generator's); per group (per line in the size sweep), every distinct [drawn offset from the baseline in px, size in half points] of its extra runs; and the four hhea/typo integers of every face the model asked for. Measurements only; regenerate with tools/read_script_probe.py --record.
